title: Quality Attributes and Technology Choices
lead: Covers (guest session, part 3): designing for performance (latency vs throughput, caching, load balancing), scalability (scale up vs out, stateless servers, parallel and asynchronous work), reliability (availability nines, single points of failure, timeouts, retries, circuit breakers), security (authentication, authorisation, never trust the client, encryption, hashing, SQL injection, secrets), reuse (library vs framework), SQL vs NoSQL and team agreements. No prior lecture attendance needed.
